title: Enforce pre-archive human Task Outcome reporting
outOfScope: Mutating archived RFE-099 or RFE-100 evidence
Automatically sending a message to an external conversation channel
PR creation, merge, release publication, or branch deletion
Changing Outcome facts without structured Contract, Summary, verification, or event evidence

sources.reason: Current --archive default caused RFE-100 to archive before the required direct report.
Nested verification must not inherit the explicit report-language make override into unrelated project commands.
Current evidence-derived generator omitted recorded Summary findings and risks from the RFE-100 Outcome.
End-to-end lifecycle coverage must prove default active preservation and explicit archive behavior.
Integration coverage owns Outcome pipeline order and active-state linkage.
RFE-ISSUE-102 exposed that the coverage association did not recognize the existing Outcome integration regression for renderer changes.
Authoritative report-language rule: English, Chinese, and Japanese conversations require the matching direct-report language.
The direct report must work in installed adopter repositories, so its selected renderer must be part of the runtime payload.
Authoritative human-report requirement: evidence-bound, readable Outcome before archive; files are evidence, not a substitute for conversation.
Observed RFE-100 process violation: default ai-finish archived before the direct Outcome report.

rawUserRequest: Treat Task Outcome Report as a core AI Cockpit value. Every Work Item must provide an evidence-bound, directly readable Outcome in the conversation while still active and before archive; file paths alone are not a human report. The direct report language must match the current conversation: English, Chinese, or Japanese. Continue authorized remediation without per-item pause.

declaredIntent.summary: Make the pre-archive human Outcome boundary durable without claiming a repository script can itself send a chat message.

riskAssessment.reason: A wrong finish default can permanently remove the active human-review point; inaccurate Outcome projection can hide evidence already recorded in the Summary.

executionDecision.reason: The RFE-100 archive timing and generated Outcome omissions provide concrete, bounded evidence for a workflow and generator corrective.

preReviewWarnings: A script may render and print a report but cannot prove a human received it in a particular chat; agent protocol must perform that last delivery.
Explicit archive remains a separate user-authorized lifecycle action after direct reporting.

checkpointPolicy.reason: The finish/Outcome/archive ordering is self-referential governance behavior and needs fresh checkpoints.

acceptance: Default make ai-finish completes verification and generates/validates a complete active Outcome but does not archive the Work Item; it emits a clearly delimited, safe-to-transmit human report.
Archive remains explicit and cannot be invoked by default ai-finish; the user-facing command/help documents the pre-archive report boundary.

Outcome generation projects recorded Summary observedIssues, residual risks, guidelines, verification results, and user corrections into the corresponding evidence-backed report sections without inventing facts or scores; direct report chrome accepts the conversation-selected English, Chinese, or Japanese locale without translating arbitrary evidence prose.

Focused regressions prove default active preservation, explicit archive behavior, ordered Outcome output, structured finding/risk projection, conversation-selected report chrome, and the adopter/core/journey explicit-archive lifecycle; tests reject reintroduction of default archive behavior.
Plan, traceability, Capability Truth, and Japanese source-bound assessment evidence are aligned and regenerated; immutable RFE-099/RFE-100 archives remain untouched.
guidelines: Keep human conversation delivery explicit: the repository may print a report but cannot attest that a person received it.
Preserve fail-closed Outcome validation and archive integrity; do not weaken verification to make reporting convenient.
Use structured Summary evidence for human-readable Outcome content; do not add self-congratulatory or unproven claims.

intent.problem: RFE-100 proved that ai-finish defaulted to archive, removing the active pre-archive decision point before an agent could provide the required direct human Outcome. Its generated Outcome also reported no findings although the Summary recorded a high-severity process issue and residual hosted-CI risk.
constraints: Default finish must preserve active Contract/Summary/Outcome for report delivery.
Archive must remain an explicit separate action.
Do not alter existing archive bytes.
Do not claim stdout proves conversation delivery.
Retain schema validation, redaction, evidence binding, and no-score restrictions.
intent.rationale: The durable system boundary is to make automatic archive impossible in the ordinary finish command and to emit a structured, evidence-derived report that the agent must relay directly before explicit archive.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Successful default ai-finish leaves the Work Item active with validated Outcome artifacts and a reportable stdout section.
scenarioCoverage.reason: Protects the human review point before archive.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Contract and Summary remain active after default finish; output identifies the Outcome report and next explicit archive action.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add an isolated finish E2E regression and execute it with focused and full quality tests.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Explicit archive occurs only after a separately requested archive action and retains Outcome evidence.
scenarioCoverage.reason: Preserves archive integrity while separating it from report generation.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Explicit archive moves Contract, Summary, and Outcome artifacts only after successful finish.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Extend E2E archive coverage using the repository archive command.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Recorded process findings and residual risks appear in generated human Outcome sections without unsupported embellishment.
scenarioCoverage.reason: Prevents a technically valid but human-empty report.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Structured Summary entries produce Findings, Risks, Residual Risks, and Human Decisions or an explicit none marker.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add generator and renderer regression fixtures with recorded Summary evidence and validator checks.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized continuous execution of planned corrective Work Items.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff; active Outcomes remain reportable and archive remains explicit.
